run.name: Entegris Inc
run.title: CP-OS host session (ENTG)
run.summary: Entegris is a cyclical, concentrated but strongly cash-generative supplier whose credit profile improved in 2026: leverage on par debt over Adjusted EBITDA is 3.27x LTM Q3 2026 and nothing matures before 2028. The gain depends on demand holding. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context; the EDGAR registrant name in that context is ENTEGRIS INC.

revenue.basis: Net sales, as the CP-1 table prints it.

ebitda.basis: EBITDA, unadjusted (operating income + depreciation + amortization), as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Par debt 3295.0 and cash 356.5 at September 26, 2026 over LTM Adjusted EBITDA 1008.2. Cash includes 298.2 held outside the U.S. Excludes leases; same definition limits.

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. LTM Adjusted EBITDA 1008.2 over LTM interest paid 181.1 (185.4 plus 90.4 less 94.7). On LTM interest expense of 191.4 the same ratio is 5.27x. Same limits.

cash.basis: Cash. At September 26, 2026: commitments 750.0, maturity April 29, 2031, no borrowings. Before letters of credit (not supplied). 298.2 of cash is outside the U.S. A yen line of about 6.3 is excluded because its committed status is not stated.

cashflow.basis: Net cash from operating activities, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Covenant headroom, revolver letters of credit, ratings, guarantors and customer concentration after FY2025 are not supplied, and Adjusted EBITDA is management-defined.
CP-1 main limitation: Covenant EBITDA, revolver letters of credit and the covenant test threshold are not supplied, so covenant headroom and net revolver availability cannot be calculated.
